module_summary: 64-bit loadable arithmetic shift register: load takes data in parallel, otherwise ena shifts left/right by 1 or 8 as selected by amount.

anchors.name: q
anchors.why: 64-bit shift register contents; loaded or shifted each cycle, drives output.

anchors.name: amount
anchors.why: Selects shift direction and distance: left/right by 1 or 8.

anchors.name: load
anchors.why: Parallel load of data into q; priority over shifting.

anchors.name: ena
anchors.why: Shift enable for q when not loading.

groups.name: shift_register
groups.description: Load/shift mux selected by load, ena, amount feeding the 64-bit register q.
